title: Courses in HYU
text:
APR3044 Advanced Data Analytics
Undergraduate Course
A practice-oriented course on data analytics, visualization, and AI agent workflows.
Main topics

Introduction to R programming
Exploratory data analysis and basic visualization
Interactive data visualization (R, Tableau and Plotly)
Basic AI agents and agentic workflows
RAG, context engineering, multi-agent systems, etc

title: Courses in HYU
text:
APR8025 Data Analytics
Graduate Course
A graduate-level course on quantitative data analysis for social science research.
Main topics

Introduction to R programming
Descriptive and inferential statistics
Sampling distributions and hypothesis testing
t-tests and chi-squared tests
ANOVA and regression
